title: Piratini Palace

buildingCutout.basis: The mapped government and residential palace wings, with the open interior court preserved in the authored exterior.

terrainReference.basis: Original street sample directly in front of the midline of the government wing, beyond the wall and before the plaza.

mapIdentity.provider: OpenStreetMap multipolygon relation 2798271, with the north street and square as approach controls.
mapIdentity.scope: The native 22-corner shell and 4-corner open court of government palace relation 2798271 place the administration frontage along Rua Duque de Caxias, the lateral connecting passages and the residential range with its rounded southern projection.

note: The preserved source terrain ties the front threshold to the plaza and exposes the lower foundations toward the rear. The written restoration describes a two-storey architectural order over the stone plinth, eight giant Ionic half columns, paired center supports, dark grilles, continuous balconies and an open balustrade. The 2022 survey gives four administrative storeys and three residential storeys, counting levels outside the principal frontage composition.
